relationships.subject: Cannabidiol
relationships.evidence_quote: CBD (30 mg/kg) and PECS-101 (10 and 30 mg/kg) reversed the increased expression of TRPV1 induced by IoN-CCI in this nucleus.

relationships.subject: PECS-101
relationships.evidence_quote: CBD (30 mg/kg) and PECS-101 (10 and 30 mg/kg) reversed the increased expression of TRPV1 induced by IoN-CCI in this nucleus.

relationships.subject: Capsazepine
relationships.evidence_quote: the combination of the selective TRPV1 antagonist (capsazepine-CPZ - 5 mg/kg) with sub-effective doses of CBD (3 and 10 mg/kg) is also able to reverse the IoN-CCI-induced allodynia and hyperalgesia responses

key_findings: CBD and fluorinated analog PECS-101 reduced allodynia and hyperalgesia in rat infraorbital nerve CCI trigeminal neuralgia without motor impairment, unlike carbamazepine.
Effects are partially mediated by TRPV1 in the caudal trigeminal spinal nucleus.
